findings.description: UX-27: Full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility pass using existing axe-core + Lighthouse infrastructure. Baseline audit found 6 violations across 4 pages: 4x link-in-text-block (links in body text lacked non-color indicator), 1x color-contrast on homepage scaleStat, 1x color-contrast on prototype ShadowGate (distressHigh, primaryButton, progress). Applied 5 targeted CSS fixes: underline for body text links (article/main p/li/span), darkened secondary gray #8d949e→#6c757d, darkened distress red #e13238→#c62828, white text on primaryButton, darkened progress text. Added 4 new :focus-visible rules (homepage CTAs + ShadowGate buttons) to meet internal quality-floor requirement. Total 12 :focus-visible rules confirmed. Safety-tier badge already had text label (no change needed).

Post-remediation: 0 axe-core violations across all 7 pages. Lighthouse 100/100 on all 6 scored pages (404 at 0 due to known HTTP status navigation artifact). 4 source files changed (~52 lines CSS-only). No JS changes, no new dependencies.
